title: asplenium manilense
intro: Asplenium manilense, commonly known as the Manila fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium manilense are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, making it a promising candidate for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
